name: Spotify Now Playing Fullscreen
description: Creates a fullscreen now-playing view with large art and track info for TV ambient mode

var style = document.createElement('style'); style.textContent = '#spotify-tv-fullscreen { display:none; position:fixed; top:0; left:0; width:100vw; height:100vh; background:#000; z-index:99999; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:24px; } #spotify-tv-fullscreen.active { display:flex !important; } #spotify-tv-fullscreen img { width:400px; height:400px; border-radius:16px; box-shadow: 0 16px 64px rgba(29,185,84,0.3); } #spotify-tv-fullscreen .track-name { font-size:42px; color:#fff; font-weight:700; text-align:center; max-width:80%; } #spotify-tv-fullscreen .artist-name { font-size:28px; color:#b3b3b3; text-align:center; } #spotify-tv-fullscreen .close-btn { position:absolute; top:20px; right:30px; font-size:32px; color:#fff; cursor:pointer; background:rgba(255,255,255,0.1); border:none; border-radius:50%; width:50px; height:50px; }'; document.head.appendChild(style); var panel = document.createElement('div'); panel.id = 'spotify-tv-fullscreen'; panel.innerHTML = '
